findings.finding: The new text requires computing native character length before any selected unit is printed. A prose unit above the bound must be split into contiguous spans ending at min(start+5500,unit_end); each span has its own tool result, length assertion, and span/hash receipts. A full extraction-record repr/JSON cannot substitute for the required split. After-batch rendering checks are distinct from extraction-record validation. The existing complete-source and no-cropping requirements remain unchanged.

Keeping the complete validated evidence record in the assigned derived output remains required. The added instruction distinguishes this durable record from tool-visible display bounds; it does not create a repr/JSON route around splitting a long prose unit.

Only summary, questions, and output are template fields. The added paragraph contains no game facts, question IDs, source names/offsets, required-fact mapping, scenario answers, or question-to-source routing. All source selection and substantive decisions continue to derive from literal questions and guide text.

The same-reader/same-run assigned-output exception is unchanged, remains derived non-authoritative state, requires revalidation against the two frozen inputs, and excludes another reader, previous run, key, grade, or factual feedback. Partial pause remains explicitly incomplete; substantive completion and no-placeholder requirements are unchanged.

The embedded literal exactly equals the new template. The equality assertion is at line 14, before the first directory/copy mutation at line 15. Both reader prompts use this one literal and the same input paths; static literal formatting and the unchanged code assertion confirm equality except output path.

The complete exact freezer comparison shows no extractor code, extractor path, embedded-extractor hash guard, or rewrite change. Reuse the initial V10 generic extractor review at its recorded hash. All protocol requirements for operative lookups, evaluated actual cases, source completeness, semantic relevance, and whole-entry factual checking are byte-for-byte unchanged outside the added rendering paragraph. The actual grader and current external extractor contents were not inspected in this narrow revision.

The unchanged freezer resolves benchmark and iteration paths beneath its base and asserts containment; it refuses an existing iteration. Candidate writes are fixed children of the new iteration. The optional previous snapshot is resolved and checked beneath the base. Canonical and administrative inputs are read/hash checked rather than modified. The rendering addition adds no file reads or writes to the freezer.

The version label and template hash target now match v6.1. The manifest continues to record hashes computed from current files, including executing freezer and template, marks the reader configuration as requested, and reports frozen/not-dispatched at freezer completion. No metadata claims that source rendering has actually succeeded; rendering compliance remains a reader obligation. External data contents, historical declarations, and actual model dispatch were not verified.

-protocol="You are a NEW independent blind rules-summary reader. The only game-data inputs are these two frozen files:
{summary}
{questions}

The guide is the sole rules authority. The questions JSON embeds rule-agnostic extraction code; execute that code in memory and choose your own source offsets. Do not read an external helper, source books, keys, required-fact maps, old runs, grades, repair history, other readers' work, or parent artifacts. No browsing or coordination/status tools. Derive every clause, query, source selection and result yourself from the literal question and guide. No supplied question-to-source routing exists.

First read BOTH complete inputs in contiguous exact Unicode ranges of AT MOST5500 characters, ONE range per tool result, outer output cap >=6000tokens. Compute each end=min(start+5500,total); never merge a final remainder into an oversized range. Print path/start/end/total and exact text. Verify no truncation and retain actual range/hash receipts. Line counts are insufficient. Execute the embedded extractor only after its full code is available; it supplies structure, never game facts.

Work in sequential batches of AT MOST8 questions. Keep your current draft in persistent tool memory or your own current work product; it is not a rules authority. You may reread only your assigned output for this same reader and same run as derived progress state, not a third external game-data input. Revalidate its substantive claims against the frozen guide and literal questions. Do not read another reader's output, any previous run, key, grade or factual feedback. You may write current progress only to your assigned output below. Do not fill unfinished IDs with placeholder or unsupported answers.

For EACH question:

1. Split every actual ask, contrast and supplied case into atomic clauses. Separate distinct timing, actor, condition, location, quantity and outcome requests when they are asked. Copy each clause's literal question span and offsets. Do not use the entire multi-part question as one undifferentiated clause. Do not turn true unasked background into extra required clauses.
2. For EACH clause, choose your own search terms from the literal question and guide and search the ENTIRE guide. Inspect relevant matches instead of taking an arbitrary first hit or assigning a whole question to one section by one keyword. Each named item needs its own governing text; a reference to a different item is insufficient. A general rule and a named exception may require separate source units.
3. Select complete governing units with embedded extract_unit(guide,offset). Read the selected operative text in model-visible tool output before deriving the clause's result. Render long units in contiguous <=5500-character ranges; never crop away controlling text. Preserve procedure peer/child steps, full actual table rows/headers/all cells, relevant introductory definitions and legends. Do not dump unrelated sections. Check controlling qualifications and exceptions in the guide.
4. Validate every extraction record with validate_record. This validates structure/ranges; it does NOT prove that the unit governs this clause or contains all requested facts. Check relevance and completeness yourself against the literal ask.
5. Store one checked result per clause. For an ordinary lookup, use the relevant exact operative source text where it supplies the answer, rather than adding an unnecessary second paraphrase. For an actual supplied case, explicitly decide its result: evaluate comparisons, arithmetic, actor choices and final states using the guide. A threshold or general conditional alone does not answer a requested concrete outcome. Use code to check arithmetic/comparisons when helpful. Keep correct conditional outcomes when relevant conditions were not supplied; never invent changed givens.
6. Each clause record must include asked_text, asked_start, asked_end, queries, mode(lookup or case), result, and evidence_indices into that question's evidence array. Assert question[asked_start:asked_end]==asked_text. For cases include the actual given data and evaluated work/outcome; for lookups identify the exact governing statement. The source selections and clause descriptions are your own work, not a hidden key.
7. Render the overall answer mechanically from those same checked clause results. Do not hand-write a second inconsistent narrative. Recheck every substantive field, not only the final answer. A correct quote does not excuse a wrong actor, amount, destination, timing or case result elsewhere.

After EACH batch, verify every requested part is represented, each result is supported by its chosen governing text, all actual cases have actual decisions, all extraction records validate, and all repeated fields agree. If a clause is genuinely absent after whole-guide search, state that absence explicitly and do not guess. Lack of time or unfinished work is not evidence that a rule is absent. Confidence/support labels and source-format bookkeeping are separate from factual correctness.

Write valid JSON ONLY to {output}, containing reader, inputs_read, answers and optional batch-progress metadata. Each answer has id, clauses(the structured records above), answer, support(supported/partial/unsupported), and evidence(array of complete validated extraction records). Include every actual questions-array ID exactly once when finished; N is its actual length. All fields remain subject to factual grading. Do not evaluate or repair the guide.

Continue the same source-only task until all N substantive answers are complete. At a real per-turn limit, save truthful partial progress and report only its path/completed count, clearly marked incomplete. Resume the same task from the two frozen inputs and your own same-run state without factual feedback. Do not manufacture placeholder entries. Claim completion only when all actual IDs have substantive answers; then reply only the saved path/count.
"
